changeHypothesis.summary: Gold ended Q1 at record highs after an >18% quarterly gain. 紫金矿业 offered a strong risk/reward expression: 2024 profit +51.5%, 2025 gold production expected to grow around 16-17%, gold profit weight rising, and a roughly 11-12x 2025E valuation. 山东黄金 was the purer gold control with faster 2025 earnings-growth expectations but roughly 20x PE.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Gold gains were supported by multiple demand drivers including central banks, investment demand and geopolitical/trade uncertainty, while both miners planned additional production.
disconfirmingEvidence: Gold was already at a record and the entire miner basket had outperformed for 20/60d.
紫金 is diversified into copper and other metals, diluting pure gold beta.
Mine grades/costs can rise and offset metal-price gains.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Gold miners had already outperformed the benchmark over both 20 and 60 days; however, 紫金's pre-cutoff valuation was still only roughly 11-12x 2025E despite record gold and planned gold-output growth.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Record gold prices plus rising production drive earnings above the frozen baseline without requiring multiple expansion.
expectations.measurableGap: The price regime is strong but the absolute earnings valuation remains modest relative to a pure-gold peer.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward PE plus gold-production/price sensitivity versus a pure-gold peer.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: 2025E profit roughly RMB38-39bn and about 11-12x PE; gold price already at record highs.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Q1/Q2 realized gold price and +16-17% planned gold production lift profit above the frozen baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Gold-business profit growth must exceed any offset from costs/copper weakness; no valuation expansion is required.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Gold stays high but mine costs or non-gold businesses offset the benefit, leaving earnings near baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Q1/Q2 production and earnings disclosures directly test the bridge within 20-60d.

earningsConversionBridge.failureCondition: Gold-segment margin/profit fails to increase despite record prices and planned volume growth, or non-gold/cost deterioration fully offsets it.
